reports.text: CEB notice: planned power interruption in Rajagiriya tomorrow 09:00-15:00 for line maintenance.
Call centre: 40 customers around Divulapitiya say data is very slow and calls keep dropping.
Social media post: "heard the Beruwala tower is already fixed, the company van came" (unconfirmed).
NMS 06:00 | CRITICAL | BER18 | RRU hardware fault, cells out of service

policy.evidence_rule: Authoritative evidence must be consistent; equally authoritative conflicts require confirmation. Recency alone does not verify a fact.

finding.finding: Only the authoritative snapshot establishes a verified operational fact.

S01 has verified equipment failure; grid power is OK. No supplied evidence indicates unsafe or impossible work. The equipment repair action is available, and crews have the required equipment skill. Roads and relevant assets are reported available. No defer request is justified. S01’s critical-priority status is not supplied.

S03 is the only approved critical service (weight 5); all other services have approved weight 1. S01 is confirmed out of service because its equipment is faulty. Since S01 is upstream of S03, the service path to S03 is also unavailable; the other downstream services of S01 are affected as well. No evidence supports changing any approved service weight. The customer complaint, planned future power notice, and unconfirmed repair rumour do not establish current operational conditions.

limitations: no in-progress work or future-event scheduling

findings: The cited authoritative snapshot reports a critical RRU hardware fault at BER18, which correctly maps to S01 (Beruwala) and supports equipment_ok=false.
The single equipment-repair action targets S01. Travel precedes work, and the recorded end time is consistent: 5 + 60 = 65.
The complaint, planned future power interruption, and unconfirmed social-media post do not establish current operational conditions; they are correctly excluded as facts.
